about: Ceilings for the hub files every feature edits (docs/ci/structure-and-citations.md, "Ceilings for structure"). Checked by tools/structure-check.ps1 under CTest as structure_check. An author never edits this file: a branch that moves a hub records it in a file of its own, tools/structure-raises/<name>.json (structure-check.ps1 -Raise), and the coordinator folds those files in after a merge (-Rebaseline), keeping their reasons below.

unpinned_pages.why: a ledger that grows a row per piece of work; its diet is archiving done rows, another row's work, not a ceiling every branch would raise

hubs.why: every pass and every feature flag of a frame
the passes a frame adds inline rather than through a frame-pass seam
every play feature and every flag
every surface feature doubles the material resolve's module count
a capability wired into the viewer by hand
the same, in every source file of the app and its tests
